correction_scope: Correct the evaluation outcome wording from close-to-open to open-to-close.
Freeze the monthly expanding retraining contract and required fold artifacts.
Require a hash-bound activation manifest before any forward session is counted.

errata.interpretation: This is a wording correction only. The retrospective target, runner column oc_return_pct, and OOT protocol all define open-to-close return.

candidate.universe: Stocks with at least one qualifying overnight TDnet disclosure on a source-complete target session.
candidate.bundle: Join qualifying titles for each code in publication-time order with the frozen separator.

target.name: open_to_close_return_pct
target.training_clip: Training-period 1st and 99th percentiles, then [-10,+10] percentage points.

decision.allocation: 100% of the research sleeve to the selected shadow candidate.
decision.source_incomplete: no decision and excluded from the source-complete score counter

training_contract.fit_schedule: Fit once before the first scored session of each calendar month.
training_contract.training_sample: All qualifying event-code bundles from source-complete sessions strictly before the scored month whose target-session close and outcome were already known before fitting.
training_contract.failure_policy: Fail closed for the affected month. Do not substitute an earlier fold, partial source window, or retrospectively rebuilt unregistered artifact.

activation.eligibility_rule: The first counted session must be a source-complete JPX session whose 08:58:59 JST cutoff is strictly after the activation manifest was committed to the default branch and whose acquisition, feature, scoring, and append-only logging pipeline was running before that cutoff.
activation.pre_activation_sessions: Never backfill or count them in the forward counter.

point_in_time_contract.source_completeness: Every required calendar-date TDnet page from the previous JPX session through the target session must be present, parser-valid, finalized, and provenance-complete.
point_in_time_contract.missing_source_policy: Fail closed and record no decision; a missing page is never a no-event day.

decision_log_contract.immutability: Conflicting records for the same decision_id are rejected.

evaluation.scheduled_day_denominator: Every activated source-complete score session; valid no-event sessions contribute cash return 0.
evaluation.primary_metric: Mean daily net return at 40 bps over every activated source-complete score session.
comparators: frozen L4 price control top1 evaluated on the identical source-complete sessions
equal-weight qualifying-event mean as a selection-skill diagnostic
required_reports: gross and net mean, median, win rate, and profit factor
top 10 profit-contributing codes replaced by cash net20
maximum single-day and single-code profit contribution
paired block-bootstrap difference versus frozen L4
realized spread, slippage, turnover, minimum-lot, and capacity diagnostics when registered evidence is available

requirements: At least 120 source-complete sessions spanning at least 4 calendar months.
Net40 is positive in both chronological halves.
The one-sided paired 90% lower bound versus frozen L4 is at least zero.
Candidate generation and PIT compliance are both at least 98%.
Minimum-lot, spread, slippage, turnover, and intended-capital checks show the strategy is executable.
promotion_gate_after_window.failure_action: Retain as research or reject. Do not tune on the same forward window.
promotion_gate_after_window.production_action: A passing result is still not an order authorization; independent audit and explicit human approval remain required.
